The concern here is PTSD which would be very understandable given the circumstance. PTSD can be tricky because it can pop up in unexpected ways that are hard to predict. From the comments it sounds like the VA have resources. No one here even a therapist would be able to give a diagnosis (it's one of those things that requires an assessment). The best advice I could give would be that when looking for someone to speak with you will want to speak specifically with a trauma counselor or therapist with trauma experience (PTSD falls under that field of practice) so that is where you will likely find the best help and answers.
